item11_readme.window_entry: - `conversions_in_window(daily_counts, days)`: the sum of the last `days` entries of `daily_counts` (oldest first); `0` for `days == 0`, the whole list if `days` exceeds its length.
item11_readme.daily_entry: - `daily_conversion_counts(events, start_day, end_day)`: the number of converted sessions per day from `start_day` to `end_day` inclusive (empty list if `end_day < start_day`).

names.module_doc: Product analytics dashboard: conversion statistics over customer sessions.
names.readme_intro: Helpers for a product analytics dashboard. They load web-analytics logs of customer sessions and compute conversion rates, so that the product team can track how often sessions convert across marketing campaigns.
names.log_desc: a web-analytics log: one line per customer session
